record.question: Out of the given alternatives, choose the one which can be substituted for the given words or sentence: One for whom the whole world is one's home.
record.explanation: Answer A: cosmopolitan. A cosmopolitan is at home in many places or the world; it is the closest choice. Independent check: A cosmopolitan person is at home in many parts of the world; this is the offered match for “one for whom the whole world is one’s home.” Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/cosmopolitan.
